title: A flow cannot be uninstalled - deps-only flows have no way to free their weights

summary: Starting implementation - server guard exclude, then the drawer button.

Uninstall shipped and proven live against real weights on an isolated instance. The live run also caught a repaint defect the plan had ruled out - downloadService re-syncs only in its SSE listener, and no EventSource exists until a download starts.

reason: Reopened: user-run uninstall of Text to Speech freed 0 bytes. Two defects found - the managed-models-root rail refuses every targetPath dep, and the (flow) sentinel leaks into a duplicate toast.

Live-verified in the user's own app 2026-09-04: uninstall removed 11 / kept 2 shared / 0 refused, drawer repainted both directions with no restart, one toast, and the install-direction models:checked fan-out is proven.
